body:
## Direct from the maker in Jaipur

Boutiques and online stores abroad love Indian block prints. Buying directly from the manufacturer gives you better prices, consistent quality and designs that your local market will not find everywhere.

## What you can source

- Block print cotton dresses and kaftans
- Kurtis and tunics
- Kurta sets with pants and dupatta
- Co-ord sets and tops
- Private label production under your brand

## How export orders work

1. Share styles, quantity, sizes and destination
2. Get a catalogue, samples and a written quotation
3. Secure prepaid payment method confirmed in the written quotation
4. Production and quality check, with photos and videos
5. Dispatch by courier or cargo with commercial invoice

Import duties and taxes in your country are paid by the buyer. [WhatsApp us](https://wa.me/917073350886) or send us your [requirement](/wholesale/#enquiry).

faq.q: Which countries do you ship to?
faq.a: We ship to the USA, UK, Canada, Europe, Australia, the Middle East and most other countries.

faq.q: How do I pay for an international order?
faq.a: International orders are prepaid. The available secure payment method and currency are confirmed in the written quotation/order review.
Import duties and taxes of your country are paid by the buyer on arrival.
